Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: A municipal records office files routine applications, inspection reports, and correspondence in sealed case folders. Each item is indexed by case number, filing date, and responsible official. Amendments are attached to the original file with a notation log entry and retained under standard retention schedules.

2) What occurred: The actor submitted a pre-prepared correction form to the records clerk, altering the status field of the dated inspection record from "open violation" to "corrected." The actor provided a payment instrument to the responsible official through an unmonitored personal channel. The official signed an amendment addendum. The actor transmitted a false completion certificate to the case file via the public document portal. The actor requested closure of the case folder and deletion of the pending-flag metadata from the index.

3) Materials/access observed: A dated inspection record, a correction form, an amendment addendum, a payment instrument, a false completion certificate, a public document portal account, a case folder index, and a notation log. Access to the responsible official's personal contact information was used.

4) Indicators & artifacts: Mismatch between the original inspection date and the amendment date. Absence of a corresponding payment receipt in the official accounts ledger. Presence of a notation log entry lacking a verifying signature. Anomalous deletion event in the case folder index audit trail. Communication records on the unmonitored personal channel between the actor and the official.
